issues.claim: Redbear Tech Svc LLC (group A) category: 'IT services'
issues.problem: Opened redbeartech.com: the company sells and services medical gases and medical/dental/veterinary equipment (anesthesia machines, sterilizers, medical gas installs, ASSE 6010). Its 'Toll-free number suggests managed IT' reasoning led to the wrong category.
issues.fix: Recode as medical/laboratory equipment service & sales (group C or D depending on the group rules) and drop the IT framing.

issues.claim: Polska Szkola (Polish School) (group D) - included as an eligible business
issues.problem: Opened polishschoolnest946.com: it is a Polish supplementary school (preschool through high school, plus adult classes) run with Polish Falcons Nest 946 under Christ the Redeemer Parish, with teachers, report-age classes and exam prep. That is a school, which the rules exclude.
issues.fix: Drop it, or keep only if the owner confirms private/heritage schools are in scope; do not spend triage time on it by default.

issues.claim: Jerry Davis Early Childhood Center / The Arc of Somerset County (group D)
issues.problem: Boundary case on the 'schools' exclusion: this is a state-licensed child-care/preschool centre (infants to preschool) run by a nonprofit. Defensible as a service organisation, but it is the same kind of institution as the Polish school already flagged.
issues.fix: Get an owner ruling on childcare/preschool centres before outreach, then apply it consistently to both entries.
